data.body: Patch set 4 pushed to Gerrit change 2595. Addressed remaining LLM advisory issues within scope: --check-only without a local archive now verifies installed scanner binaries using the selected prefix; gitleaks archive extraction now streams the named binary into the destination path instead of tar.extract metadata/path handling; added observable tests for check-only dispatch and nested-archive path stripping; replaced the workflow prose-substring assertion with a structural runs-on assertion. Evidence before push: targeted + held-out oracle 178 passed; make lint passed; make typecheck passed.
